name: Abyssal Sacrifice

pages.text: Craft through JEI and place in the Altar of Abyss at the Sunken City.

pages.title: Obtaining
pages.text: The native shapeless recipe combines Athame, Nautilus Shell, Heart of the Sea, coral material and valuable resource blocks. Crystallized Coral and Coral Chunk have separate variants; JEI shows active ingredients.

pages.title: Offering
pages.text: Interact with the Altar of Abyss while holding it. The altar takes one offering and consumes it after successfully spawning Leviathan. Using the item in the air does not summon the boss.

pages.title: Next
pages.text: Prepare underwater breathing and swimming room. Confirm Start on a dedicated server; singleplayer uses native awakening. $(l:handbook/bosses/cataclysm/the_leviathan)Leviathan defenses and tactics$(/l).
